title: Improving floating-point precision in CSS color functions
author: yisibl
summary: Keeps hsl()/hwb() as `CssColor::Float` (unboxed) instead of converting to 8-bit RGBA at parse time, rewrites HSL->RGB in f64 per spec, and turns a percentage-calc `unreachable!()` into a parse error. Fixes several WPT rounding cases and un-comments many hwb color-mix tests. The maintainer asked for a benchmark of the unboxing and there has been no answer since.
evidence: devongovett review comment 2026-09-26 on color.rs:64: "Do you have a benchmark for this? It was originally boxed to reduce the size of CssColor since most of the time colors are 8-bit RGB." No reply. Copilot's open thread (2026-09-10) is valid: `get_features()` on master maps every `CssColor::Float` to `SpaceSeparatedColorNotation`, so legacy comma `hsl(0, 0%, 0%)` would now be treated as modern syntax inside `@supports`. Also unflagged: JS visitors will now see `{type:'hsl'|'hwb'}` for hsl()/hwb() inputs instead of `{type:'rgb'}` (FloatColor serde tag), a visible AST change (the playground's default visitor checks `color.type === 'rgb'`). Several existing expected outputs change by one channel unit (e.g. #797245b3 -> #787245b3); justified by WPT-style rounding but worth a browser check in the full review.

Thanks for digging into this, the rounding fixes and the newly enabled hwb tests are great to have!

A few things are still open before this can go further:

- **Boxing:** could you share a benchmark for storing `FloatColor` inline? It was boxed to keep `CssColor` small, since most colors are 8-bit RGB, so it'd be good to see the size and speed impact. If it doesn't clearly help, keeping the `Box` is fine.
- **`@supports`:** with hsl()/hwb() now always stored as `Float`, `get_features()` reports space-separated color syntax even for legacy `hsl(0, 0%, 0%)`. Inside `@supports (color: hsl(0, 0%, 0%))`, colors that need lowering for older browsers could then be left as is. Keeping track of whether the input used the legacy comma syntax would avoid that.
- **JS visitors:** `hsl()`/`hwb()` colors now reach visitors as `{type: 'hsl'}`/`{type: 'hwb'}` instead of `{type: 'rgb'}`, so a `Color` visitor that checks for `rgb` stops matching them. Could you call that out in the description (or keep the RGB shape when nothing is lost)?

Thanks!
